notes:
Mark Carney is the current prime minister of Canada, as of today, Oct 12, 2026.

- Wikipedia's list of Canadian prime ministers calls him the 24th and current prime minister. He took office on 14 March 2025.
- The Prime Minister's official site, pm.gc.ca, says he was elected Leader of the Liberal Party of Canada and sworn in as Prime Minister in March 2025.
- Britannica's Carney page lists news items dated Oct. 6 and Oct. 8, 2026. They still call him Canada's leader, so he is still in office as of this week.
- Britannica says he became prime minister after the government of Justin Trudeau collapsed.

The official pm.gc.ca page was about a year old when the search ran. The recent confirmation comes from Britannica's news items and from Wikipedia, whose Carney page showed as updated today.
